name: contrast-audit
description: Audit the Contrast Demo screen for WCAG contrast ratio violations
steps:
  - tool: launchApp
    appId: dev.jasonpearson.automobile.playground
    clearAppData: true
    label: Launch Playground app with clean state

  - tool: observe
    label: Wait for home screen to be stable

  - tool: tapOn
    id: demo_index_action
    label: Navigate to Demo Index

  - tool: observe
    label: Wait for Demo Index to load

  - tool: tapOn
    id: demo_a11y_contrast_action
    label: Navigate to Contrast Demo screen

  - tool: observe
    label: Wait for Contrast Demo screen to load
    expectations:
      - type: elementVisible
        selector:
          testTag: contrast_content

  - tool: auditAccessibility
    auditType: contrast
    wcagLevel: AA
    label: Audit contrast ratios against WCAG 2.1 Level AA
    expectations:
      - type: hasAccessibilityIssues
        description: Expect to find contrast violations on low-contrast elements

  - tool: observe
    label: Verify specific low-contrast elements are present
    expectations:
      - type: elementVisible
        selector:
          testTag: contrast_low_text
      - type: elementVisible
        selector:
          testTag: contrast_low_button

# both "Done" and "Add". The plan accepts either label, then verifies the saved title.
# Deliberately does NOT clearAppData: on newer iOS a cleared Reminders launches to a home without
# the "New Reminder" control, which would break this plan.
platform: ios
steps:
  # coldBoot force-terminates + relaunches so the plan starts from the Reminders home rather than a
  # partial edit screen left by a failed or interrupted local run. coldBoot (unlike clearAppData)
  # keeps the app data, so it avoids the empty-home issue noted above.
  - tool: launchApp
    appId: com.apple.reminders
    coldBoot: true
    label: Launch Reminders (cold, for clean retry state)

  - tool: observe
    waitFor:
      text: "Reminders"
      timeout: 20000
    label: Wait for Reminders UI

  # A prior local run can leave Reminders restored inside a smart list such as Today. Return to the
  # accounts/list home first so the next hop can choose the default Reminders list deterministically.
  - tool: observe
    waitFor:
      text: "Back"
      timeout: 2000
    optional: true
    label: Wait for list back button (if restored inside a list)

  - tool: tapOn
    selector:
      text: "Back"
    action: "tap"
    optional: true
    label: Return to Reminders accounts home (if restored inside a list)

  # Reminders intermittently shows an "Enable iCloud Syncing?" alert on launch that covers the
  # list and blocks the create/save controls. It appears on some simulators (fresh state, no iCloud
  # account) and not others, which is the flaky-test root cause (issue #2811): when present the
  # later taps fail, when absent the plan sails through. Dismiss it best-effort — both the wait and
  # the tap are optional, so a run where the alert never appears skips them and continues instead of
  # failing.
  - tool: observe
    waitFor:
      textAny:
        - "Not Now"
        - "Close"
      timeout: 5000
    optional: true
    label: Wait for the iCloud syncing alert (if shown)

  - tool: tapOn
    selector:
      textAny:
        - "Not Now"
        - "Close"
    action: "tap"
    optional: true
    label: Dismiss the iCloud syncing alert (if shown)

  # Some iOS versions launch to the accounts home, where the create control is only available after
  # entering the default Reminders list. This optional hop is skipped when the plan already starts in a
  # list that shows "New Reminder".
  - tool: observe
    waitFor:
      textAny:
        - "Reminders, 0 reminders"
        - "Reminders,"
      timeout: 2000
    optional: true
    label: Wait for default Reminders list row (if on accounts home)

  - tool: tapOn
    selector:
      textAny:
        - "Reminders, 0 reminders"
        - "Reminders,"
    action: "tap"
    optional: true
    label: Open default Reminders list (if on accounts home)

  # Reminders can also ask for location permission before exposing the create control. Dismiss this
  # best-effort so local/simulator privacy state does not block the add flow.
  - tool: observe
    waitFor:
      text: "Don’t Allow"
      timeout: 5000
    optional: true
    label: Wait for location permission alert (if shown)

  - tool: tapOn
    selector:
      text: "Don’t Allow"
    action: "tap"
    optional: true
    label: Dismiss location permission alert (if shown)

  # Wait for the create control to render before tapping it, so the tap doesn't race the shade/list
  # layout on a slow simulator.
  - tool: observe
    waitFor:
      text: "New Reminder"
      timeout: 10000
    label: Wait for New Reminder control

    text: "New Reminder"
    action: "tap"
    label: Focus new reminder field

  # return as soon as the press is recognized, while the sheet is still animating in.

    waitFor:
      text: "Title"
      timeout: 10000
    label: Wait for title field

    text: "it's"

      textAny:
        - "Done"
        - "Add"
      timeout: 10000
    label: Wait for save control

    selector:
      textAny:
        - "Done"
        - "Add"
    action: "tap"
    label: Save reminder

  - tool: observe
    waitFor:
      text: "it's"
      timeout: 10000
    label: Verify saved reminder title

    appId: dev.jasonpearson.automobile.playground
    clearAppData: true
    label: Launch Playground app with clean state

  - tool: observe
    label: Wait for home screen to be stable

  - tool: tapOn
    id: demo_index_action
    label: Navigate to Demo Index

  - tool: observe
    label: Wait for Demo Index to load

  - tool: tapOn
    id: demo_perf_list_action
    label: Navigate to Performance List

  - tool: observe
    label: Wait for Performance List to load
    expectations:
      - type: elementVisible
        selector:
          testTag: performance_item_1_action

  - tool: tapOn
    id: performance_item_1_action
    label: Tap to navigate to detail screen

  - tool: observe
    label: Measure transition performance to detail screen
    expectations:
      - type: elementVisible
        selector:
          testTag: performance_detail_content

  - tool: tapOn

    action: "tap"

    text: "6"

    action: "tap"

  - tool: tapOn
    id: "com.google.android.deskclock:id/material_minute_tv"
    label: Switch to minute selection
    action: "tap"

  - tool: tapOn
    text: "30"
    label: Select 30 for minutes
    action: "tap"

  - tool: tapOn
    text: "OK"
    label: Confirm alarm time selection
    action: "tap"

  - tool: terminateApp
    appId: com.google.android.deskclock
